user.title: Configure Staykey
user.description: Enter the gateway token from your Staykey dashboard (Properties > Integrations > Home Assistant) to connect this Home Assistant instance to Staykey.

error.gateway_token_required: A gateway token is required. Copy it from your Staykey dashboard under Properties > Integrations > Home Assistant.

data_description.allow_support_actions: Off by default. While it is off, this integration refuses troubleshooting commands: calling any service, reading the codes stored on your locks, and watching the event bus. Staykey doesn't need them to run your properties.

gateway_token_required.message: This Staykey entry has no gateway token. Staykey now connects only through its gateway: copy the token from your Staykey dashboard (Properties > Integrations > Home Assistant) and add it under Configure.
